# Organizations

This folder catalogs the organizational backbone of the Danish healthcare system as it relates to the monitoring, governance, and delivery of atrial fibrillation care. It encompasses the full spectrum of healthcare entities, from national health authorities, medical societies, and data infrastructure providers that set standards and track quality indicators, down to the regional administrations, municipalities, hospitals, and specific clinics where patient care is actually delivered. By grouping these organizations, the wiki maps the complex, multi-tiered network of public agencies, registries, and clinical units that collaborate to evaluate and improve cardiovascular treatment outcomes across Denmark.

## Pages

- [[entities/organizations/clinics/index|Clinics]] — Specialized and regional clinics benchmarked against national quality indicators for atrial fibrillation treatment and patient education.
- [[entities/organizations/health-authorities/index|Health Authorities]] — Central governmental bodies responsible for managing national health data, clinical databases, and quality development programs.
- [[entities/organizations/health-data-infrastructure/index|Health Data Infrastructure]] — Analytical units and prescription registries that form the data-processing backbone for clinical quality evaluations.
- [[entities/organizations/health-databases/index|Health Databases]] — National clinical quality databases, such as the Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), that track specific medical conditions and treatment standards.
- [[entities/organizations/health-infrastructure/index|Health Infrastructure]] — Foundational data pipelines and administrative frameworks, including national laboratory databanks and regional health cluster structures.
- [[entities/organizations/health-quality-infrastructure/index|Health Quality Infrastructure]] — Professional units and organizations that oversee, review, and evaluate clinical quality standards across the healthcare system.
- [[entities/organizations/health-registries/index|Health Registries]] — National and regional registries supplying essential clinical, laboratory, and administrative data for quality monitoring.
- [[entities/organizations/health-standards/index|Health Standards]] — Governance structures and steering committees that establish healthcare standards and validate clinical indicator targets.
- [[entities/organizations/healthcare-registries/index|Healthcare Registries]] — Local healthcare clusters (sundhedsklynger) tracked for their performance against national clinical quality indicators for cardiovascular care.
- [[entities/organizations/hospital-units/index|Hospital Units]] — Specific hospital departments and specialized units operating within broader healthcare organizations.
- [[entities/organizations/hospitals/index|Hospitals]] — Danish hospitals and specialized facilities evaluated for their compliance with national atrial fibrillation treatment and diagnostic standards.
- [[entities/organizations/medical-societies/index|Medical Societies]] — Professional societies and interest groups that provide clinical governance, guidelines, and standardized criteria for care.
- [[entities/organizations/municipalities/index|Municipalities]] — Local Danish municipalities benchmarked for decentralized healthcare quality, particularly regarding DOAC safety practices and stroke prevention.
- [[entities/organizations/regions/index|Regions]] — The administrative healthcare regions of Denmark and their structural shift toward population-based, cross-sectoral health clusters.
